# Learn2Vibe

> > Learn2Vibe teaches practical skills through step-by-step tutorials spanning international cooking and web development projects.

Learn2Vibe offers hands-on guides for cooking authentic dishes from Cuban, Brazilian, French, Vietnamese, and Indian cuisines, alongside coding tutorials for data visualization, web scraping, and building analytics dashboards with tools like Bolt.new, React, and Supabase.

## Key Topics

- International Cuisine
- Cuban Recipes (Ropa Vieja)
- Brazilian Desserts
- French Cooking
- Vietnamese Pho
- Indian Street Food
- Web Scraping
- Data Visualization
- Bolt.new
- React & TypeScript
- Vegetarian Recipes
- Comfort Food
- Rice Noodles
- Casino Analytics
- CSV Data Management

## International Dinner Recipes

- [How to Make Authentic Vietnamese Beef Pho with Rice Noodles](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-authentic-vietnamese-beef-pho-with-rice-noodles): Vietnamese Beef Pho: aromatic broth with rice noodles & Thai basil
- [How to Make Authentic Cuban Ropa Vieja with Tender Shredded Beef](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-authentic-cuban-ropa-vieja): Cuban Ropa Vieja recipe: shredded beef in tomato sauce with peppers
- [How to Make Authentic Aloo Tikki with Chole and Mint Chutney](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-authentic-aloo-tikki-with-chole-and-mint-chutney): Indian street food: Aloo Tikki potato patties with Chole & mint chutney
- [How to Make Flavorful Vegetarian Pad See Ew with Crispy Tofu](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-flavorful-vegetarian-pad-see-ew-with-crispy-tofu): Thai vegetarian Pad See Ew with crispy tofu & rice noodles
- [How to Make Traditional French Pot-au-Feu with Beef and Root Vegetables](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-traditional-french-pot-au-feu): French Pot-au-Feu: slow-cooked beef stew with root vegetables
- [How to Make Authentic Carciofi alla Giudia (Roman Jewish-Style Artichokes)](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-carciofi-alla-giudia-roman-jewish-style-artichokes): Roman Jewish Carciofi alla Giudia: double-fried crispy artichokes
- [How to Make Delectable Escargot with Garlic and Herb Butter](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-escargot-with-garlic-and-herb-butter): French Escargot recipe with garlic-herb butter for special occasions
- [How to Make Spiced Roasted Cauliflower and Red Lentil Curry](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-spiced-roasted-cauliflower-and-red-lentil-curry): Indian-inspired cauliflower & red lentil curry, vegetarian comfort food
- [How to Make Crispy White Bass Fish Cakes with Herb-Infused Mashed Potatoes](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/dinner/how-to-make-crispy-white-bass-fish-cakes-with-herb-infused-mashed-potatoes): White bass fish cakes with herb-infused mashed potatoes comfort food

## Data Visualization & Web Scraping Projects

- [How to Build a Casino Data Management and Scraping Prototype with Bolt.new](https://www.learn2vibe.com/coding/data-visualization/casino-data-management-scraping-prototype): Build casino data scraping prototype with Bolt.new, CSV uploads & analytics

- [How to Make Classic Brazilian Brigadeiros with Rainbow Sprinkles](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/desserts/how-to-make-classic-brazilian-brigadeiros-with-rainbow-sprinkles): Brazilian brigadeiros: chocolate truffles with rainbow sprinkles, no-bake
- [How to Make Crispy Tajadas with Caramelized Sweet Plantains](https://www.learn2vibe.com/cooking/snacks/how-to-make-crispy-tajadas-with-caramelized-sweet-plantains): Caribbean/Latin American Tajadas: crispy caramelized sweet plantains
